conceptZh: 玩具機器人小心翼翼地端著一桶黑色顏料走路，在完全平坦的地上莫名絆了一下，整桶顏料倒扣在自己身上，全身變得黑漆漆只剩兩顆圓眼睛；旁邊的小鴨只被噴到一個黑點，低頭看了看，又抬頭看看他。
object: a small toy robot, a bucket of black paint and a tiny rubber duck
morph: the glyph 黑 stands still as a solid sculpture while the paint gag plays out at its base
creativeAngle: 顏色字最怕抽象，直接讓角色整個變成那個顏色最好懂；笑點用「在完全平坦的地上絆倒」的無理由，加上小鴨只中一滴的對比收尾。黑十二畫、下面四點最容易連成一條線，字體靜止並特別要求四點分開。語音詞「黑色」，黑ㄏㄟ、色ㄙㄜˋ都是單一讀音。
promptEn: Create an exactly 8-second 3D stylized toy animation as one continuous locked-off shot on a clean solid pale cream background. One correctly formed Traditional Chinese character 黑 stands centered the whole time as a flat-fronted sculpture in saturated deep ink black, filling about 70% of the frame height with comfortable margins on all sides. Use standard textbook proportions: the upper section sits above four separate dots along the bottom, and those four dots must stay clearly apart from each other and never merge into a bar. The glyph never moves, rotates, tilts or gets covered, and the camera stays locked. At its base a small boxy toy robot carries a bucket of black paint with enormous care, taking tiny deliberate steps across completely flat, completely empty floor, tongue out in concentration. A tiny yellow rubber duck sits watching to his right. At 1.8 seconds he trips over absolutely nothing. The bucket flips up and lands neatly upside-down over him, and when it lifts away at 2.4 seconds he is glossy black from head to toe, with only two round white eyes blinking out. He looks down at himself. Beat. At 3.2 seconds the duck, which has received exactly one small black spot on its back, cranes round to inspect the spot, then looks up at the robot, then back at the spot. The robot gives the duck a slow, dignified nod, and the two of them walk out of frame together to the right by 4.6 seconds. From 4.7 seconds to 8.0 seconds the frame is completely still and clean, holding on the single centered 黑 with nothing else in shot. Style: Pixar-like glossy chunky toy materials, soft studio lighting, bright high-contrast colors that are vivid but never neon, no dark or moody grading, no white blowouts. Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice speaks clear Taiwanese Mandarin and says exactly 「黑、黑、黑色」, using the reading ㄏㄟ for 黑 both on its own and inside the word. Speak the first 黑 around 0.5 seconds, the second around 2.0 seconds, and 黑色 around 5.6 seconds while the finished glyph is held still, with natural pauses, then stop; do not keep chanting the character or repeat the line. Keep every sound effect soft and clear of the voice, and use no music louder than the voice. The spoken word is audio only and must not be added to the picture. The only writing anywhere in the frame is the single character 黑: no subtitles, no vocabulary text, no other letters, numbers, watermarks, scenery, extra props, particles, lens flare, motion blur on the glyph, or flashing effects.

conceptZh: 太空人玩偶漂浮時，黑色顆粒從四邊偷偷溜進來，最後排成「黑」。
object: bouncy astronaut toy and drifting ink dots
morph: black dots arrive and become the four dots below 里
creativeAngle: 黑點從邊緣探頭、躲開主角、最後歸位。
promptEn: Create an exactly 8-second animated comedy, locked frontal camera. Setting: a pale-banana-yellow stage; the glyph is a solid charcoal black 黑 with four round dots on the bottom row. A bouncy astronaut figure in a fishbowl helmet floats slightly above the floor at left. The Traditional Chinese glyph 黑 stays centered and uncropped at about 70% of frame height with generous margins. Moment one (0.0-1.8s): four fluffy charcoal dots peek in from the edges and dodge the astronaut's reaching glove; the first 黑 is spoken as the first dot peeks in. Moment two (1.8-3.5s): the astronaut drifts upward in a slow somersault; the dots dart in and settle under the upper box one by one, the upper strokes sliding in at the same time; the second 黑 is spoken as the last dot lands. Moment three (3.5-5.0s): a toy blackboard on little wheels rolls in with chalk dust puffing; 黑板 is spoken as it stops. From 5.0-8.0s the glyph 黑 is perfectly still and unobstructed; the astronaut floats down, holds a piece of chalk and does a slow wave while the glyph holds. Audio: one warm, friendly off-screen voice speaks slowly and distinctly in Taiwan-standard Mandarin, reading exactly these syllables with clear tones and no erhua: 「黑、黑、黑板」 (ㄏㄟ、ㄏㄟ、ㄏㄟ ㄅㄢˇ). Timing: first utterance at about 0.5s, second at about 2.5s, the word at about 4.4s; then stop, no repeats and no extra speech. Beneath the voice only soft pops and chalk taps, no music. The single glyph is the only on-screen text; the vocabulary stays audio-only with no subtitles, watermark, clutter or flashing.
